entries.topic: How the theology shield works: Genesis 12:3 as policy argument; criticism recast as opposition to God; named officials and pastors, dated

claims.text: ICEJ (Malcolm Hedding, executive director emeritus): Genesis 12:3 is the verse 'most often referred to as their biblical mandate'; defines a Christian Zionist as 'a Christian who supports the Jewish people's right to return to their homeland'; says 'Zionism' 'has been turned into a negative word by Israel's enemies' and Christian Zionism is 'under attack and often misrepresented'.

Cruz–Carlson interview released 18 June 2025: Cruz said he came to Congress intending to be 'the leading defender of Israel in the United States Senate'; cited 'Those who bless Israel will be blessed, and those who curse Israel will be cursed'; 'as a Christian, growing up in Sunday school, I was taught from the Bible'; said 'I don't have the Scripture off the tip of mind'; Carlson: 'Those who bless the government of Israel?'; Cruz: the verse 'doesn't say the government of' but 'the nation of Israel'; Carlson: 'What does that even mean?'

Christian Post: Cruz called it his personal motivation; said 'Not everyone I represent is a Christian, so I don't use my faith as the reason we should support Israel'; 'most people understand that line in Genesis to refer to the Jewish people'; Carlson: 'We're commanded as Christians to support the government of Israel?'

Jewish Insider: interview released 18 June 2025; the wording Cruz used is closer to Numbers 24:9; Cruz's main stated justification was national security ('Israel is doing a massive favor to America right now by trying to take out Iran's nuclear capacity').

Robert Jeffress, sermon at First Baptist Dallas, 22 June 2025: 'Unlike any other nation in the world, God created the nation of Israel'; 'Those who oppose Israel are always on the wrong side of history'; 'And most importantly, they're on the wrong side of God'; 'Tucker, let me help you out.'

Jeffress (CBN, 1 Jan 2017) after the US failed to veto a UN Security Council resolution condemning settlements: Obama and Kerry 'are on the wrong side of God on this issue'; 'God will judge any nation that divides the land that God gave to Israel'.

Word&Way (Kaylor, 2 Oct 2025): Netanyahu at a White House press conference with Trump on 29 Sept 2025: 'It's also in the Bible. It says, Those who will bless you will be blessed, and those who will curse you will be cursed'; Speaker Mike Johnson in July 2025: 'I'll bless the nation that blesses Israel and curse the nation that curses Israel'; Kaylor: Genesis 12:3 'does not actually mention Israel since Israel didn't yet exist at that point in the story'.

Carrie Prejean Boller (Catholic, former Miss California USA), at the Religious Liberty Commission hearing on antisemitism, 9 Feb 2026: 'Catholics do not embrace Zionism, just so you know. So are all Catholics antisemites?'; asked whether speaking about 'what many Americans view as a genocide in Gaza' should be treated as antisemitic; reiterated that 'Jews killed Jesus'; said Candace Owens 'just doesn't support Zionism'.

Chair Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick announced her removal on X on 11 Feb 2026: 'No member of the Commission has the right to hijack a hearing for their own personal and political agenda on any issue'; 'This was my decision.' She told EWTN members had asked her to resign months earlier; on X she called her stance a 'matter of Catholic conscience' and said she would not surrender her 'religious liberty' to 'Zionist supremacy'.

entries.topic: Where the shield fails: Christian rebuttals, the Kirk/TPUSA split, AmericaFest 2025

claims.text: Heschmeyer (Catholic Answers, 25 Jun 2025), responding to Cruz: the promises 'apply to whoever shares the faith of Abraham, including the faithful Gentiles' (Gal 3:7-9); calls the reading tying the promise to the modern state 'disastrous theology, since it undermines the New Covenant itself'.

Charlie Kirk's letter to Netanyahu dated 2 May 2025 (published by the New York Post, reported by JTA 30 Sep 2025): he was 'defending Israel in public more than your own government'; 'This should be a 5 alarm fire'; Israel 'is losing the information war'; 'from a place of deep love for Israel and the Jewish people'; said he was called 'a paid apologist for Israel' and accused of antisemitism. Kirk was shot at Utah Valley University, Orem, on 10 Sep 2025; Netanyahu appeared to cite the letter in a pre-emptive denial of Israeli involvement.

AmericaFest, Phoenix, 18-21 Dec 2025: Tucker Carlson: 'God is not on any country's side'; 'If a man commits a crime, do we kill his kids? I don't care if it's in Minneapolis or Gaza City. No, we don't'; criticised Christian ministers he said justified killing in Gaza. Ben Shapiro called Carlson's hosting of Nick Fuentes 'an act of moral imbecility' and said Candace Owens had been 'vomiting all sorts of hideous and conspiratorial nonsense'. Bannon called Shapiro and others the 'Israel First' crowd. Owens did not attend.
